compute_passive_forces: compute passive forces including springs, dampers, gravity compensation, and fluid effects on a MuJoCo model
apply_joint_spring_damper_forces: apply joint-level spring and damping forces for free, ball, slide, and hinge joints
apply_tendon_spring_damper_forces: apply tendon-level spring and damper forces mapped to joint space via the tendon Jacobian
compute_gravity_compensation: compute body-level gravity compensation forces using body mass and gravcomp coefficients
compute_fluid_forces: compute fluid forces including viscosity, lift, and drag using inertia-box approximation
